verdict.rationale: Riveter is a web scraping and enrichment service, so a real-time dashboard for system metrics and worker/browser pool status is a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence shows no such dashboard. 'Monitor for Changes' refers to scheduled data refreshes, and run listing, polling and webhooks report job status only; neither is live metrics or pool monitoring.

support.subject: As a developer, I can monitor live system metrics and worker/browser pool status through a real-time dashboard
